assets.prompt: Original language-learning educational illustration, warm gouache on ivory paper with cobalt blue, teal and coral accents, landscape 3:2. A woman in a coral shirt in a cozy simple kitchen looks puzzled while searching an empty bread basket on the counter. Behind her to the right a man in a blue shirt is holding the missing loaf of bread, clearly visible to the viewer. Bread is the only salient object, no other food, no clutter. Friendly adults, natural hands and expressive faces, elegant painted texture. The example will be '¿Dónde está el pan? No lo encuentro.' All language and captions added separately in HTML. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles. This scene must visually show why she cannot find the bread although it is nearby.
